tools.note: registry: external with an A3 override; draft here until the kernel A3 list carries it

tools.autonomy: A3: runs at once for system, agents and members whose role may call it

routes: POST /v1/uploads/contacts (rawBody, 20 MB: one request or ordered parts; JSON over a cookie, text/csv for API keys)
POST /hooks/contacts/:sourceId (HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + '.' + exact body bytes, 300 s skew, idempotent on eventId)

tests.full_suite: 241/241 on the rebased head (a078004+); 233/233 in 2 of 3 earlier full runs, the other failed only the then 60 s scale budget (74.4 s). Ceiling now 120 s (open.2026-10-21.intake-scale-contention)

works: CSV/TSV/semicolon/pipe with RFC 4180 quoting, BOM, CRLF; delimiter detection
Column mapping by Hindi/English header synonyms, then value shapes; Aadhaar/PAN/bank/OTP columns ignored by design and never stored

Per-row preview with shared/phone.ts reason codes (SCI_NOTATION, NON_INDIAN, TOO_SHORT, LANDLINE_TRUNCATED, EMPTY, INVALID_PREFIX), Devanagari digits, duplicate-in-file, existing/suppressed/tombstoned flags, at most 3 questions

One write path for files and webhooks: exact E.164 dedupe (plus merged phone identifiers), attribute authority by subject (self vs record) with max_age; stale values lose authority; equal authority from different systems goes to an intake_attribute_conflict review row; a tenant's own uploads are one lineage
Consent appended with evidence and purpose; a DB trigger refuses UPDATE (except a merge re-pointing contact_id) and direct DELETE

Suppression never cleared by import; opt-out columns and webhook optOut add one; contact.suppress works for numbers not on file; contact.suppress_after_opt_out runs at once as A3 for system/agent and waits for approval for members

DPDP erase_me: tombstone (HMAC with a per-workspace salt), suppression kept and re-keyed to the hash, attributes/aliases/audiences/memory facts removed, contact kept as a husk so consent history survives; re-import, webhook and dial_facts all refuse the person; forget_memory scope
contact.dial_facts for the dial gate: tombstone, suppressions, DND (unknown or older than 7 days fails closed for promotional), latest consent per purpose, service/promotional verdicts with reasons
DND provider seam: FakeDndProvider for tests, DisabledDndProvider (always unknown) as the production default
contact.merge (external, A2): attributes by authority, every FK to contact re-pointed (found from pg_constraint), merged number kept as an identifier, 30-day snapshot
contact.export (A2): formula-escaped CSV, suppressed and erased excluded by default, the file is redacted from action.result

Audiences: saved attribute filters compiled to parameterised SQL (all/any; eq, neq, in, gt/gte/lt/lte on numbers or ISO dates, exists, missing, contains), list audiences from an import, preview with matched/suppressed/callable/DND-unknown
Viewers get PII scrubbed in reads
Tenancy: every query filters by workspace; tested across 13 tools and the upload route
50,000-row import (2.94 MB, 7 columns) commits in one transaction in 19.4-21.7 s alone, re-import 7.7-13.0 s (n=7); 16-81 s inside the full suite (n=7) (measure.2026-10-21.intake-50k-import)

Risk classes follow research/2026-10-21/blueprint/data/workspace-tool-registry.json (consent.record policy, contact.merge external, export/DPDP Owner+Compliance), except contact.suppress (see needs_from_others)
untested: XLSX and Google Sheets (no parser: the build adds no new packages)
Unmerge (the 30-day snapshot is stored; there is no tool yet)
Resolving an attribute conflict (rows are written; no resolve tool yet)
A real NCPR/DND lookup (adapter disabled by design)
Two concurrent commits with overlapping numbers (the ON CONFLICT path is written, not exercised)
Commit time for a full 20 MB file (only the 2.9 MB / 50k-row file was timed)
API-key scopes on the upload route; webhook rate limiting
Erasure of transcripts and recordings (calls module), CRM delete via an outbox

needs_from_others.what: Add contact.suppress to shared/approval.ts A3_VERBS (the registry marks it external with an A3 risk-lowering override); intake will then switch it from draft to external. Likewise dpdp.request.execute's override 'A3 when the person asked on a call' has no kernel path yet.
A way to call another module's tool inside the caller's transaction (registry.execute opens its own). DPDP erase writes memory_fact directly today instead of calling contact.memory.forget.
Done by the main loop in a078004 (campaigns gate G3/G4 use server/identity.ts and hash-only suppressions). contact.dial_facts remains available for previews and other paths.
On forget_request rows (status done, receipt.surfaces.pending) erase transcripts and recordings for contact_id, or expose a tool intake can call.
A vault for intake_source.hook_secret (plaintext column today) and a rotate-secret tool.
Audience membership via audience.preview / contact.list {audienceId}; contact.get returns stale per attribute for ATTRIBUTE_STALE.
A truncated landline written with its leading 0 (e.g. 022 2345 67) reports TOO_SHORT, not LANDLINE_TRUNCATED. Fine for the gate; the receipt reason is less precise.
